title: Press conference: John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Following their final appearance on The Mike Douglas Show, John Lennon and Yoko Ono held a press conference in Philadelphia.

The 45-minute event was held at the Warwick Hotel. Lennon and Ono were joined by political activist Jerry Rubin, and fielded questions on subjects including future live shows, their time in the United States, and their recent social action campaigns.
